en: When I was young, my family lived overseas.
zh: 我小的时候，我们家住在海外。

en: I lived in Indonesia for a few years.
zh: 我在印度尼西亚住了几年。

en: And my mother, she didn't have the money to send me where all the American kids went to school,
zh: 我母亲没有钱送我去那些美国孩子上的学校，

en: but she thought it was important for me to keep up with an American education.
zh: 但她觉得，让我跟上美国教育的进度很重要。

en: So she decided to teach me extra lessons herself Monday through Friday,
zh: 所以她决定从周一到周五，亲自给我额外补课，

en: but because she had to go to work, the only time she could do it was at 4:30 in the morning.
zh: 但因为她还要去上班，她唯一能教我的时间就是凌晨四点半。

en: Now, as you might imagine, I wasn't too happy about getting up that early.
zh: 现在，你们也能想象，我并不太愿意起那么早。

en: And a lot of times I'd fall asleep right there at the kitchen table.
zh: 很多时候，我会直接趴在厨房桌子上睡着。

en: But whenever I'd complain, my mother would just give me one of those looks and she'd say,
zh: 但每当我抱怨的时候，我母亲就会用那种眼神看着我，然后说，

en: this is no picnic for me either, buster.
zh: 这对我来说也不是什么轻松事，小子。

en: So I know that some of you are still adjusting to being back at school,
zh: 所以我知道，你们当中有些人还在适应重新回到学校，

en: but I'm here today because I have something important to discuss with you.
zh: 但我今天来到这里，是因为我有一件重要的事要和你们谈。

en: I'm here because I want to talk with you about your education.
zh: 我来到这里，是因为我想和你们谈谈你们的教育。

en: and what's expected of all of you in this new school year.
zh: 以及在这个新的学年里，对你们每个人的期待。

en: I've given a lot of speeches about education and I've talked about responsibility a lot.
zh: 我做过很多关于教育的演讲，也经常谈到责任。

en: I've talked about teachers' responsibility for inspiring students and pushing you to learn.
zh: 我谈过教师的责任，那就是激励学生，推动你们学习。

en: I've talked about your parents' responsibility.
zh: 我谈过你们父母的责任。

en: for making sure you stay on track and you get your homework done.
zh: 那就是确保你们不偏离正轨，完成你们的家庭作业。

en: and don't spend every waking hour in front of the TV or with the Xbox.
zh: 不要把醒着的每一个小时都花在电视机前，或者玩 Xbox。

en: I've talked a lot about your government's responsibility for setting high standards and supporting teachers and principals,
zh: 我也经常谈到政府的责任，那就是制定高标准，支持教师和校长，

en: and turning around schools that aren't working.
zh: 并扭转那些运转不良的学校。

en: where students aren't getting the opportunities that they deserve.
zh: 也就是那些学生没有得到应有机会的学校。

en: But at the end of the day, we can have the most dedicated teachers,
zh: 但说到底，我们可以拥有最敬业的老师，

en: the most supportive parents, the best schools in the world.
zh: 最支持你们的父母，以及世界上最好的学校。

en: and none of it will make a difference.
zh: 但这一切都不会产生任何作用。

en: None of it will matter unless all of you fulfill your responsibilities,
zh: 这一切都没有意义，除非你们每个人都履行自己的责任，

en: unless you show up to those schools, unless you pay attention to those teachers,
zh: 除非你们走进学校，除非你们认真听老师讲课，

en: unless you listen to your parents and grandparents and other adults, and put in the hard work it takes to succeed.
zh: 除非你们听父母、祖父母和其他成年人的话，并付出取得成功所需要的努力。

en: And that's what I want to focus on today.
zh: 这就是我今天想重点谈的内容。

en: the responsibility each of you has for your education.
zh: 你们每个人对自己教育所承担的责任。

en: I want to start with the responsibility you have to yourself.
zh: 我想先从你们对自己承担的责任说起。

en: Every single one of you has something that you're good at.
zh: 你们每一个人都有自己擅长的东西。

en: Every single one of you has something to offer.
zh: 你们每一个人都有可以贡献的东西。

en: And you have a responsibility to yourself to discover what that is.
zh: 你们有责任为自己发现那到底是什么。

en: That's the opportunity an education can provide.
zh: 这就是教育能够提供给你们的机会。

en: Maybe you could be a great writer.
zh: 也许你可以成为一名出色的作家。

en: maybe even good enough to write a book or articles in a newspaper,
zh: 甚至优秀到可以写书，或者为报纸写文章，

en: but you might not know it until you write that English paper,
zh: 但你也许要等到写那篇英语论文时，才会发现这一点，

en: that English class paper that's assigned to you.
zh: 也就是那篇布置给你的英语课论文。

en: Maybe you could be an innovator or an inventor, maybe even good enough to come up with the next iPhone or the new medicine or vaccine,
zh: 也许你可以成为一名创新者或发明家，甚至优秀到能发明下一代 iPhone，或者新的药物或疫苗，

en: but you might not know it until you do your project for your science class.
zh: 但你也许要等到完成科学课的项目时，才会发现这一点。

en: Maybe you could be a mayor or a senator or a Supreme Court Justice,
zh: 也许你可以成为市长、参议员，或者最高法院大法官，

en: but you might not know that until you join student government or the debate team.
zh: 但你也许要等到加入学生会或辩论队时，才会知道这一点。

en: And no matter what you want to do with your life.
zh: 无论你将来想在人生中做什么，

en: I guarantee that you'll need an education to do it.
zh: 我向你保证，你都需要教育才能做到。

en: You want to be a doctor or a teacher or a police officer.
zh: 你想成为医生、教师或者警察。

en: You want to be a nurse or an architect, a lawyer or a member of our military.
zh: 你想成为护士、建筑师、律师，或者我们军队的一员。

en: You're going to need a good education for every single one of those careers.
zh: 这些职业中的每一个，都需要良好的教育。

en: You cannot drop out of school and just drop into a good job.
zh: 你不能辍学，然后就直接掉进一份好工作里。

en: You've got to train for it and work for it and learn for it.
zh: 你必须为它接受训练，为它努力，为它学习。

en: And this isn't just important for your own life and your own future.
zh: 而这不仅仅对你自己的人生和未来很重要。

en: What you make of your education will decide nothing less than the future of this country.
zh: 你如何对待自己的教育，将决定的绝不仅仅是这个国家的未来。

en: The future of America depends on you.
zh: 美国的未来取决于你们。

en: What you're learning in school today will determine whether we as a nation can meet our greatest challenges in the future.
zh: 你们今天在学校所学的东西，将决定我们这个国家未来能否应对最重大的挑战。

en: You'll need the knowledge and problem-solving skills.
zh: 你们将需要知识和解决问题的能力。

en: you learn in science and math to cure diseases like cancer and AIDS,
zh: 也就是你们在科学和数学中学到的能力，去治愈癌症和艾滋病这样的疾病，

en: and to develop new energy technologies and protect our environment.
zh: 并开发新的能源技术，保护我们的环境。

en: You'll need the insights and critical thinking skills.
zh: 你们将需要洞察力和批判性思维能力。

en: you gain in history and social studies to fight poverty and homelessness,
zh: 也就是你们在历史和社会研究中获得的能力，去对抗贫困和无家可归，

en: crime and discrimination. and make our nation more fair and more free.
zh: 对抗犯罪和歧视，让我们的国家更加公平、更加自由。

en: You'll need the creativity and ingenuity you develop in all your classes to build new companies.
zh: 你们将需要在所有课程中培养出来的创造力和聪明才智，去创办新的公司。

en: that will create new jobs and boost our economy.
zh: 这些公司将创造新的工作岗位，并推动我们的经济发展。

en: We need every single one of you to develop your talents and your skills and your intellect
zh: 我们需要你们每一个人都发展自己的天赋、技能和智力，

en: so you can help us old folks solve our most difficult problems.
zh: 这样你们才能帮助我们这些老家伙解决最困难的问题。

en: If you don't do that, if you quit on school.
zh: 如果你们不这样做，如果你们放弃学校，

en: you're not just quitting on yourself, you're quitting on your country.
zh: 你们放弃的不只是自己，你们也是在放弃自己的国家。

en: I know it's not always easy to do well in school.
zh: 我知道，在学校取得好成绩并不总是容易的。

en: I know a lot of you have challenges in your lives right now.
zh: 我知道你们当中很多人现在生活中面临着各种挑战。

en: that can make it hard to focus on your schoolwork.
zh: 这些挑战会让你们很难专注于学业。

en: I get it. I know what it's like.
zh: 我明白。我知道那是什么感觉。

en: My father left my family when I was two years old.
zh: 我父亲在我两岁的时候离开了我的家庭。

en: and I was raised by a single mom who had to work.
zh: 我由一位不得不工作的单身母亲抚养长大。

en: and who struggled at times to pay the bills and wasn't always able to give us the things that other kids had.
zh: 她有时为了支付账单而苦苦支撑，也并不总能给我们其他孩子拥有的东西。

en: There were times when I missed having a father in my life.
zh: 有些时候，我会想念生命中有父亲陪伴的感觉。

en: There were times when I was lonely and I felt like I didn't fit in.
zh: 有些时候，我感到孤独，觉得自己格格不入。

en: So I wasn't always as focused as I should have been on school,
zh: 所以我并不总是像本该做到的那样专注于学校，

en: and I did some things that I'm not proud of.
zh: 我也做过一些让我并不自豪的事。

en: and I got in more trouble than I should have.
zh: 我惹的麻烦也比我本该惹的更多。

en: And my life could have easily taken a turn for the worse.
zh: 我的人生本来很容易走向更糟的方向。

en: But I was lucky.
zh: 但我很幸运。

en: I got a lot of second chances.
zh: 我得到了很多重新来过的机会。

en: and I had the opportunity to go to college and law school and follow my dreams.
zh: 我有机会去上大学、读法学院，并追随自己的梦想。

en: My wife, our First Lady, Michelle Obama, she has a similar story.
zh: 我的妻子，我们的第一夫人，米歇尔·奥巴马，她也有类似的经历。

en: Neither of her parents had gone to college.
zh: 她的父母都没有上过大学。

en: and they didn't have a lot of money.
zh: 他们也没有很多钱。

en: But they worked hard and she worked hard so that she could go to the best schools in this country.
zh: 但他们努力工作，她也努力学习，所以她才能进入这个国家最好的学校。

en: Some of you might not have those advantages.
zh: 你们当中有些人也许没有这些优势。

en: Maybe you don't have adults in your life.
zh: 也许你的生活中没有成年人。

en: who give you the support that you need.
zh: 能够给你所需要的支持。

en: Maybe someone in your family has lost their job and there's not enough money to go around.
zh: 也许你的家人中有人失业了，家里的钱不够用。

en: Maybe you live in a neighborhood where you don't feel safe.
zh: 也许你住在一个让你没有安全感的社区。

en: or have friends who are pressuring you to do things you know aren't right.
zh: 或者有朋友在逼你去做一些你知道并不正确的事。

en: But at the end of the day, the circumstances of your life,
zh: 但说到底，你生活中的环境，

en: what you look like, where you come from, how much money you have,
zh: 你的外貌、你的出身、你有多少钱，

en: what you've got going on at home.
zh: 你家里正在发生什么事。

en: none of that is an excuse for neglecting your homework or having a bad attitude in school.
zh: 这些都不能成为你忽视作业，或者在学校态度不好的借口。

en: That's no excuse for talking back to your teacher or cutting class or dropping out of school.
zh: 这些都不能成为你顶撞老师、逃课或者辍学的借口。

en: There is no excuse for not trying.
zh: 不努力，没有任何借口。

en: Where you are right now doesn't have to determine where you will end up.
zh: 你现在所处的位置，不必决定你最终会走到哪里。

en: No one has written your destiny for you.
zh: 没有人替你写好你的命运。

en: Because here in America, you write your own destiny.
zh: 因为在美国，你们书写自己的命运。

en: You make your own future.
zh: 你们创造自己的未来。

en: That's what young people like you are doing every day all across America.
zh: 这正是像你们这样的年轻人每天在美国各地做的事。

en: Young people like Jasmine Perez, from Roma, Texas.
zh: 像来自得克萨斯州罗马市的贾斯敏·佩雷斯这样的年轻人。

en: Jasmine didn't speak English when she first started school.
zh: 贾斯敏刚开始上学时不会说英语。

en: Neither of her parents had gone to college.
zh: 她的父母都没有上过大学。

en: But she worked hard, earned good grades.
zh: 但她努力学习，取得了好成绩。

en: and got a scholarship to Brown University as now in graduate school studying public health,
zh: 她获得奖学金进入布朗大学，现在正在研究生院学习公共卫生，

en: on her way to becoming Dr Jasmine Perez.
zh: 正在朝着成为贾斯敏·佩雷斯医生的方向前进。

en: I'm thinking about Andoni Schultz from Los Altos, California.
zh: 我还想到来自加利福尼亚州洛斯阿尔托斯的安多尼·舒尔茨。

en: who's fought brain cancer since he was three.
zh: 他从三岁起就一直与脑癌抗争。

en: He's had to endure all sorts of treatments and surgeries.
zh: 他不得不承受各种各样的治疗和手术。

en: one of which affected his memory, so it took him much longer,
zh: 其中一次手术影响了他的记忆力，所以他需要花更长的时间，

en: hundreds of extra hours, to do his schoolwork.
zh: 多出数百个小时，才能完成他的功课。

en: But he never fell behind.
zh: 但他从来没有落后。

en: He's headed to college this fall.
zh: 今年秋天，他将进入大学。

en: And then there's Chantelle Steve from my hometown of Chicago, Illinois.
zh: 然后还有来自我家乡伊利诺伊州芝加哥的尚特尔·史蒂夫。

en: Even when bouncing from foster home to foster home in the toughest neighborhoods in the city,
zh: 即使在这座城市最艰难的社区里，从一个寄养家庭辗转到另一个寄养家庭，

en: she managed to get a job at a local health care center,
zh: 她还是设法在当地一家医疗中心找到了一份工作，

en: start a program to keep young people out of gangs.
zh: 还发起了一个项目，帮助年轻人远离帮派。

en: and she's on track to graduate high school with honors and go on to college.
zh: 她也正在以优异成绩高中毕业，并继续进入大学。

en: And Jasmine, Andoni, and Chantelle aren't any different from any of you.
zh: 贾斯敏、安多尼和尚特尔，和你们任何人都没有什么不同。

en: They've faced challenges in their lives just like you do.
zh: 他们在生活中也面临着和你们一样的挑战。

en: In some cases, they've got it a lot worse off than many of you.
zh: 在某些情况下，他们的处境比你们很多人还要艰难得多。

en: But they refuse to give up.
zh: 但他们拒绝放弃。

en: They chose to take responsibility for their lives.
zh: 他们选择为自己的生活承担责任。

en: for their education, and set goals for themselves.
zh: 为自己的教育承担责任，并为自己设定目标。

en: And I expect all of you to do the same.
zh: 我也期待你们所有人都这样做。

en: And that's why today I'm calling on each of you to set your own goals for your education,
zh: 这就是为什么今天我要号召你们每一个人为自己的教育设定目标，

en: and do everything you can to meet them.
zh: 并尽你所能去实现它们。

en: Your goal can be something as simple as doing all your homework,
zh: 你的目标可以很简单，比如完成所有家庭作业，

en: paying attention in class, or spending some time each day reading a book.
zh: 上课认真听讲，或者每天花一些时间读一本书。

en: Maybe you'll decide to get involved in an extracurricular activity or volunteer in your community.
zh: 也许你会决定参加一项课外活动，或者在社区做志愿服务。

en: Maybe you'll decide to stand up for kids who are being teased or bullied
zh: 也许你会决定为那些因为自己是谁、因为外表而被取笑或欺负的孩子挺身而出，

en: because of who they are or how they look, because you believe,
zh: 因为你相信，

en: like I do, that all young people deserve a safe environment to study and learn.
zh: 就像我一样，所有年轻人都应该拥有一个安全的环境来学习和成长。

en: Maybe you'll decide to take better care of yourself so you can be more ready to learn.
zh: 也许你会决定更好地照顾自己，这样你就能更好地准备学习。

en: And along those lines, by the way, I hope all of you are washing your hands a lot,
zh: 顺便说到这一点，我希望你们所有人都经常洗手，

en: and that you stay home from school when you don't feel well
zh: 也希望你们在感觉不舒服的时候待在家里，不要去学校，

en: so we can keep people from getting the flu this fall and winter.
zh: 这样我们就能防止人们在今年秋冬感染流感。

en: But whatever you resolve to do, I want you to commit to it.
zh: 但无论你决定做什么，我都希望你认真承诺下来。

en: I want you to really work at it.
zh: 我希望你真正为它努力。

en: I know that sometimes you get that sense from TV that you can be rich and successful without any hard work,
zh: 我知道，有时候电视会让你产生一种感觉，好像不用努力也能变得富有和成功，

en: that your ticket to success is through rapping or basketball or being a reality TV star.
zh: 好像你通往成功的门票就是说唱、打篮球，或者成为真人秀明星。

en: Chances are you're not going to be any of those things.
zh: 你很可能不会成为那些人中的任何一种。

en: The truth is, being successful is hard.
zh: 事实是，成功很难。

en: You won't love every subject that you study.
zh: 你不会喜欢你学习的每一门科目。

en: You won't click with every teacher that you have.
zh: 你也不会和你遇到的每一位老师都很合拍。

en: Not every homework assignment will seem completely relevant to your life right at this minute.
zh: 并不是每一项家庭作业都会在此时此刻看起来和你的生活完全相关。

en: And you won't necessarily succeed at everything the first time you try.
zh: 你也不一定第一次尝试每件事就能成功。

en: That's okay. Some of the most successful people in the world are the ones who've had the most failures.
zh: 这没关系。世界上一些最成功的人，恰恰是经历过最多失败的人。

en: J.K. Rawlings, who wrote Harry Potter.
zh: 写《哈利·波特》的 J.K. 罗琳。

en: her first Harry Potter book was rejected 12 times before it was finally published.
zh: 她的第一本《哈利·波特》在最终出版之前，被拒绝了十二次。

en: Michael Jordan was cut from his high school basketball team.
zh: 迈克尔·乔丹曾被高中篮球队淘汰。

en: He lost hundreds of games and missed thousands of shots during his career.
zh: 在他的职业生涯中，他输掉过数百场比赛，投丢过数千次球。

en: But he once said, I have failed over and over and over again in my life,
zh: 但他曾经说过，我一生中一次又一次、反反复复地失败，

en: and that's why I succeed.
zh: 这正是我成功的原因。

en: These people succeeded because they understood that you can't let your failures define you.
zh: 这些人之所以成功，是因为他们明白，你不能让失败定义你。

en: You have to let your failures teach you.
zh: 你必须让失败教会你。

en: You have to let them show you what to do differently the next time.
zh: 你必须让失败告诉你，下一次应该怎样做得不同。

en: So if you get into trouble.
zh: 所以，如果你惹了麻烦。

en: that doesn't mean you're a trouble maker.
zh: 那并不意味着你就是一个麻烦制造者。

en: It means you need to try harder to act right.
zh: 这意味着你需要更加努力地做正确的事。

en: If you get a bad grade, that doesn't mean you're stupid.
zh: 如果你考了低分，那并不意味着你很笨。

en: It just means you need to spend more time studying.
zh: 这只意味着你需要花更多时间学习。

en: No one's born being good at all things.
zh: 没有人生来就擅长所有事情。

en: You become good at things through hard work.
zh: 你是通过努力才变得擅长某件事的。

en: You're not a varsity athlete the first time you play a new sport.
zh: 你第一次尝试一项新运动时，并不会马上成为校队运动员。

en: You don't hit every note the first time you sing a song.
zh: 你第一次唱一首歌时，也不会每个音都唱准。

en: You've got to practice.
zh: 你必须练习。

en: The same principle applies to your schoolwork.
zh: 同样的原则也适用于你的学业。

en: You might have to do a math problem a few times before you get it right.
zh: 你可能要做几次数学题，才能把它做对。

en: You might have to read something a few times before you understand it.
zh: 你可能要读几遍某段内容，才能真正理解。

en: You definitely have to do a few drafts of a paper before it's good enough to hand in.
zh: 你肯定要把一篇文章改上几稿，才能好到可以交上去。

en: Don't be afraid to ask questions.
zh: 不要害怕提问。

en: Don't be afraid to ask for help when you need it.
zh: 在需要帮助的时候，不要害怕寻求帮助。

en: I do that every day.
zh: 我每天都这样做。

en: Asking for help isn't a sign of weakness, it's a sign of strength.
zh: 寻求帮助不是软弱的表现，而是力量的表现。

en: Because it shows you have the courage to admit when you don't know something,
zh: 因为这说明你有勇气承认自己不知道某件事，

en: and that then allows you to learn something new.
zh: 而这也会让你学到新的东西。

en: So find an adult that you trust, a parent, a grandparent.
zh: 所以，去找一个你信任的成年人，比如父母、祖父母。

en: or a teacher, a coach, or a counselor.
zh: 或者老师、教练，或者辅导员。

en: and ask them to help you stay on track to meet your goals.
zh: 请他们帮助你保持在实现目标的正轨上。

en: And even when you're struggling, even when you're discouraged.
zh: 即使你正在挣扎，即使你感到沮丧。

en: and you feel like other people have given up on you, don't ever give up on yourself.
zh: 即使你觉得别人已经放弃了你，也永远不要放弃自己。

en: Because when you give up on yourself, you give up on your country.
zh: 因为当你放弃自己的时候，你也放弃了你的国家。

en: The story of America isn't about people who quit when things got tough,
zh: 美国的故事并不是关于那些一遇到困难就放弃的人，

en: it's about people who kept going, who tried harder.
zh: 而是关于那些坚持前行、更加努力的人。

en: who loved their country too much to do anything less than their best.
zh: 他们太爱自己的国家，所以绝不会少做低于最好水平的事。

en: It's the story of students who sat where you sit 250 years ago and went on to wage a revolution,
zh: 这是那些两百五十年前坐在你们现在座位上的学生，后来发动革命的故事，

en: and they founded this nation, young people.
zh: 也是他们创建这个国家的故事，年轻人。

en: Students who sat where you sit 75 years ago who overcame a depression and won a world war,
zh: 这是那些七十五年前坐在你们现在座位上的学生，战胜大萧条并赢得世界大战的故事，

en: who fought for civil rights and put a man on the moon.
zh: 也是他们为民权而奋斗，并把人类送上月球的故事。

en: Students who sat where you sit 20 years ago who founded Google and Twitter and Facebook and changed the way we communicate with each other.
zh: 这是那些二十年前坐在你们现在座位上的学生，创办了 Google、Twitter 和 Facebook，改变了我们彼此沟通方式的故事。

en: So today, I want to ask all of you, what's your contribution going to be?
zh: 所以今天，我想问你们所有人，你们将作出什么贡献？

en: What problems are you going to solve?
zh: 你们将解决什么问题？

en: What discoveries will you make?
zh: 你们将作出什么发现？

en: What will a President who comes here in 20 or 50 or 100 years say about what all of you did for this country?
zh: 二十年、五十年，或者一百年后，来到这里的一位总统，会怎样评价你们为这个国家所做的一切？

en: Your families, your teachers and I are doing everything we can to make sure you have the education you need to answer these questions.
zh: 你们的家人、老师和我，都在尽我们所能，确保你们拥有回答这些问题所需要的教育。

en: I'm working hard to fix up your classrooms and get you the books and the equipment and the computers you need to learn.
zh: 我正在努力修缮你们的教室，为你们提供学习所需要的书本、设备和电脑。

en: But you've got to do your part, too.
zh: 但你们也必须做好自己那一份。

en: So I expect all of you to get serious this year.
zh: 所以我期待你们所有人在今年认真起来。

en: I expect you to put your best effort into everything you do.
zh: 我期待你们在所做的每一件事上都付出最大的努力。

en: I expect great things from each of you.
zh: 我期待你们每一个人都成就伟大的事情。

en: So don't let us down.
zh: 所以不要让我们失望。

en: Don't let your family down or your country down.
zh: 不要让你的家人失望，也不要让你的国家失望。

en: Most of all, don't let yourself down.
zh: 最重要的是，不要让你自己失望。

en: Make us all proud.
zh: 让我们所有人为你们感到骄傲。

en: Thank you very much, everybody.
zh: 非常感谢大家。

en: God bless you. God bless America Thank you.
zh: 上帝保佑你们。上帝保佑美国。谢谢。
